objective: Advance the BTC +500% annual objective by measuring actual modeled one-account trades, not overlapping markouts. No promised outcome.
additional_date_status: Preselected before reading this event tape. This date was previously seen at candle resolution, so not completely pristine market history.
signal_profile: Reuse BTC Pressure event_study closed-receive-second features and the unchanged Mechanisms. Export frames through an observer without tuning thresholds. Clock/source semantics are those of the existing archive profile, not the raw-message live recorder.
execution: Existing Broker, one position and one pending entry maximum. Merge actual Bybit trades, depth-five snapshots, ticker context and deterministic frame/timer events in provider receive order. No fill at a future quote before latency. Passive orders consume visible queue and opposing prints; exits consume only available displayed depth. Model constraints and defects are separately tested.
settings_origin: Experimental assumptions retained for comparability, not personal account instructions or historical fee entitlements.
selection: None. All five settings reported on all available sessions. Primary is fixed original_passive, never chosen by later profit.
funding: Ticker funding rate remains forecast. Preserve unresolved obligations and invalidate full-performance claims when any held settlement cannot be priced from authentic realized funding. Do not silently replace missing rates with zero.
session_boundary: Each sampled day starts a separate account. Stop new entries and cancel pending entries 60 seconds before the observed day ends, request reduce-only close, and retain any unfilled residual as incomplete. This boundary liquidation is an explicit sampling rule, not the original multiday strategy.
stress_policy: Same frozen raw signal tape across scenarios. Execution, cost gate, quantity and subsequent account state may differ. No martingale or leverage escalation.
validation: cash ledger and all fills reconcile
single exposure, cancel races and depth consumption
no valid annual claim on sparse dates
annual_acceptance: At least 365 continuously covered days after selection, >500% net return, fees/funding and risk constraints verified, out-of-selection and execution stress evidence. Sparse session profits are not annualized. No live trading.
